record_scope_reconstruction: Article 31 of Colombia decree 1702 ordered closure of authorised land and river border posts from October 28 at 18:00 to October 29, 2023 at 16:00, with force-majeure exceptions. Local reporting expressly identifies Rumichaca, Mataje and San Miguel for vehicles and pedestrians both directions. This is a nationwide set of authorised posts, not every metre of each national frontier.

source_checks.finding: Primary PDF inspected, page 11 Article 31: authorised terrestrial and river posts, 22-hour ordered window and exceptions; no list or geometry for all posts.
Full El Universo report inspected: Colombian-side Rumichaca barriers; explicitly names Rumichaca, Mataje and San Miguel, vehicle and pedestrian flows in/out.
Full local report inspected: Ipiales mayor announces Rumichaca closure during exact national window. Its decree-number phrasing is inconsistent with primary decree, which governs.
